data.name: 你好！我们还有场恋爱没谈-番外篇
data.detailed_description:
"Surprisingly, what makes this game stand out from competitors on the market is its inclusion of an epilogue. As the saying goes, confessing your feelings is just the first step—true understanding comes with time."

"If judged purely by its pace, that would be a serious misunderstanding. The completeness and emotional depth of this title are exceptionally rare, even among the many interactive movies and games I’ve experienced. After achieving all accomplishments and witnessing every ending, I found that certain choices still led to unexpected turns—that, I believe, is the greatest charm of interactive cinematic games."

Since the release of *Hello Love: 18 Again*, we have received countless heartwarming responses. Each of the five distinct heroines has gathered her own loyal following—it is your genuine affection that breathes life into them and gives deeper meaning to our creation.

Moved by such overwhelming love, we have always hoped to respond in a special way. That’s why, while preparing the extra chapter, we held a vote, inviting you to decide the protagonist of the first story. In the end, through your collective choice, Ms. Lu became the center of this chapter.

This is not only a recognition of her character but also a tacit promise between us and all our players. In this dedicated story, we will step together into the subtler aspects of her daily life, experience the vivid sides beyond her gentleness, and listen to the unspoken thoughts within her heart.

Thank you for your unwavering companionship. Now, please push open this door and meet her from another perspective.

 

An emotional labyrinth interweaving reality, memory, and possibility. It reflects the struggles behind the seven-year itch, the costs behind every choice, and the truest answer within your heart.

Every word you say and every move you make will tip the scales of life, determining the final outcome of this relationship.

May you follow your heart in this cyber trial marriage.

 

Follow Your Heart: A Trial Marriage Sim

  • Emotionally Profound Narrative:

    Experience a mature love story that goes far beyond sweet fantasies. It tackles real-life issues like the "seven-year itch," long-distance struggles, workplace boundaries, and personal growth. Your partner of seven years, Ms. Lu, is not just a character to be "won over"—she's a vividly portrayed individual with complex emotions and an independent life. Your understanding and choices will shape the final form of this relationship.

  • Surreal Guidance and Reflection:

    Glimpse fragmented endings from parallel futures. These are not mere previews, but a stark "what-if" test that forces you to step outside your own perspective, re-examine your bond with your partner, and reflect on the true meaning of love.

  • Rich Content to Explore:

    Investigate environments carefully, collect old videos, message logs, and hidden clues on your phone. These fragments are not just sweet memories—they may piece together truths you’ve overlooked and unlock key paths to hidden story branches and special endings.

  • Unique "Dual-Track Narrative" Experience:

    As the main story unfolds, you will have the chance to directly experience memory fragments from another parallel version of yourself. Memories from "elsewhere" will surge into your present life like a tide, allowing you to feel the intensity, restraint, and regrets of emotions in different circumstances. The story between you and Ms. Lu extends far longer than a single lifetime.

 

"Love" isn’t always a grand declaration. More often, it’s a bowl of noodles late at night, an embrace after a long day, or seven years of unwavering support and patience.

This is not just a simple romance game—it’s a rehearsal for the future.

This time, be true to your heart...

data.short_description: More than a dating sim—this is your "cyber trial marriage." Each dialogue, choice, and interaction delicately shifts the balance. Will you stand firm or adapt for love? Confront or avoid the challenges? Rewind to before the promise is made, and let life's scales reveal where your heart truly leans.
